The replay adds no alternate reaction availability flag, pending trigger copy, readied response ledger, movement-spend copy, concentration flag, or save-DC cache.

notes: Task 73 introduced no new durable state fields.
Reaction availability remains BattleCreatureState.reactionAvailable and resets through existing turn lifecycle code.
